fields.System.Title: OUT-406 — Re-assign an abandoned task
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want work abandoned mid-shift to return to the pool, so that an
order is not stuck because someone went home.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an assigned pick task with no activity for the configured timeout, then its
  • unconfirmed lines return to the pool.
  • - Given lines already confirmed, then they stay confirmed and are not reissued.
  • - Given the reassignment, then the new picker sees only the outstanding lines.
  • - Given a supervisor, then they can force reassignment before the timeout.
  • - Given any reassignment, then the task history records both pickers.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | pick_task, pick_task_line |
| Risks | Reissuing already-picked lines causes double consumption ([doc 09 §4.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
